User.text:
Read first: .arbos/docs/project-context.md, then .arbos/notes.md
Task: 
  Create a practical guide with code examples
   API usage, and basic trading strategies
Do: as the task says; number your steps in your first reply
Rules: Start from the base branch you are given; a code fix goes on its own branch (`git checkout -b fix/<what>`), committed and pushed there, and comes back as a draft pull request (`pr create`) against that base — never a commit on the base branch; never merge. No extra documents beyond what the task needs. Secrets come through `secret` by name, never printed; redact them in captures.
Output: Deliverables under .arbos/docs/, working notes under .arbos/internal/, captures under .arbos/media/<topic>/. Verify each file exists before you report it.
Report: A markdown guide covering trading basics, API examples, and beginner strategies
